register_torchvision_models: register all torchvision models into the model_zoo_factory at import time
get_builder_model: create a wrapped builder function for a specific torchvision model with pretrained weight support
get_model_builder_version: retrieve the model constructor from torchvision using version-aware logic
list_torchvision_models: list all available torchvision model names based on the installed torchvision version
pretrained_download_wrapper: wrap a model builder with pretrained_download to handle weight downloads from the hub
